This website presents selected coursework and analytical exercises completed for ISSS608: Visual Analytics and Applications at Singapore Management University. It includes hands-on exercises, in-class work, and take-home assignments covering data visualization, exploratory analysis, geospatial techniques, and interactive data storytelling.

Together, these works reflect my learning journey in visual analytics and my interest in communicating insights through clear, structured, and engaging visual design.

Materials here are based on [https://isss608-ay2025-26apr.netlify.app/](https://isss608-ay2025-26apr.netlify.app/lesson) by Prof Kam Tin Seong from SMU.
